$comment: "Hide for me" (design: phase 4.1). Every client's test replays these: pf-client-core hide.rs, and the Swift and Kotlin ports. A client offers the action only for the profile it plays as on a host (its saved pick), and only when that profile's enumerate row says person: true. A host that never sends person has no action: no probing.

offer.name: the saved pick's row says person: offered, named after the profile
an old host sends no person: no action
no saved pick: no action, whatever a row says
another profile's row says person, not the pick's
the pick is gone from the list
a host with no profiles (enumerate answered 404)

$offer: listed: the enumerate rows (null: the host has no profiles). pick: the saved pick's id (null: Ask every time). offered: the display_name the entry's words carry ("Hide for Kid"), or null for no entry.

set_hidden.name: an id is one path segment: unreserved characters and ':' stay, the rest is escaped
not this profile's person (any more): the host's sentence, by its code

body.error: This device can't change this profile. Ask the host's owner to change it in the web console.

set_hidden.said: This device can't change this profile. Ask the host's owner to change it in the web console.

set_hidden.name: the profile is gone

body.error: That profile is gone from this host. Pick another one.

set_hidden.said: That profile is gone from this host. Pick another one.

set_hidden.name: a sentence with no code is the operator's line, never shown: the client words the failure

body.error: this profile's library lists no such title

set_hidden.name: a newer host's code: its English stands
no sentence: the client words the failure ("Couldn't hide …")

$set_hidden: One PUT per hide or show: path and JSON body exactly as written (the profile in as=, percent-encoded like the library fetch's). reply.body null is an empty body. outcome done: the title leaves the shelf (or joins it) at once and the cached catalog for that host and profile follows, with no new fetch. refused, only for a body with a code: show `said`, the host's sentence (worded by apierr_<code> where the client has that message, else the host's English), nothing changes. An error with no code is an operator's line and counts as failed. failed: the client's lib_hide_failed / lib_show_failed with the cause; nothing changes.

hidden_list.name: every page, the cursor before as
a row not marked hidden is never listed: a host that ignores the flag lists nothing
a failed page fails the list: no retry without as, no other route

body.error: That profile is gone from this host. Pick another one.

$hidden_list: Fetched when the player opens the hidden games, never cached, never with the catalog. host answers each path, matched as written; a path it does not list answers 404 with no body. asked: every path, in order. ids: the titles shown (dimmed, each offering lib_show_for), or null when the list fails to load.
